message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "unknown admin user added, who did this?" They want to know who added the unknown admin. According to DOC-060 parts: It says an existing admin can remove the unrecognised user immediately, and reporting to support gets a review of how the user was added—whether through compromised admin account, misused invite link, etc. The review examines invite and access history, handled case by case by a human reviewer. So we should advise them to remove the user and report to support for review. Provide answer accordingly. No need to escalate. Provide short answer.

arguments.message: If you see an admin you don’t recognize, first remove them right away via Settings → People.
